_readme: DATA-01 / REV-01 / REV-02 / REV-04: one synthetic table read by BOTH app/test/engine/parser/declined_state_cues_table_test.dart and process-ios-sms/parse_test.ts. expect: review = the transaction did not complete (never confirmed money in either direction; the on-device capture lands in Smart Inbox, the server rejects it); payment = a completed purchase that must keep parsing as spending; credit = a genuine refund/reversal that must keep parsing as a credit. engineType records a pre-existing on-device type that DATA-01 does not change (`استرجاع` is not a refund cue in ParserEngine._detectType); serverDirection likewise records the deterministic server direction DATA-01 does not change (`reversal` is not a server credit keyword, `purchase` is a debit one).
